description: A script that stitches together NetLog files from a specified directory into a single log file, handling JSON event files and optional end log.

methods.name: get_event_file_sort_key
methods.description: Returns a tuple (modification timestamp, file number) for sorting event files.

methods.name: get_ordered_event_files
methods.description: Returns a list of event file paths ordered from oldest to newest.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command line arguments, reads event files, and stitches them into a single NetLog file.
